Sam C. (CSM): @Anya heads-up — AstraNova reached out asking to onboard a custom multilingual legal summarizer. They say the data will include PHI and payment info, and they need private deployment + HSM. Can we intake?
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Thanks Sam. Quick qs: do they need dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) or private control plane (VPC/on-prem)? Any latency SLOs?
Sam C. (CSM): They asked for private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS/HSM and annual compliance audit. Wants p95 generate < 400ms for 512-token summaries. Prefer 13B family, but open to smaller if cost/latency tradeoffs better.
Rahul P. (Safety): Flagging safety path — PHI + PCI requires full safety review and extraction controls. We'll need a sanitized sample and a labeled failure-mode doc. Also require red-team prompts and eval rubric before rollout.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Cool. I'll kick off intake. Can we get a 500-doc eval set (no raw PHI — synthetic or redacted ok) and representative prompts in EN/ES/FR? Also need expected taxonomy for summaries (high/med/low risk).
Liang W. (Runtime Eng): From runtime side: 13B on Private is supported; quantization + HSM key wrapping might affect kernel choices. If they insist on HSM crypto for model weights at rest, we'll need the ops checklist filled and a short infra design doc. Latency target seems tight for 512 tokens depending on instance size.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): I'll propose a phased plan: 1) Safety/evals + sample dataset, 2) Private POC (non-prod VPC), 3) perf tuning (batching/kv-cache) and HSM enablement, 4) Prod cutover.
Sam C. (CSM): I'll request the eval set and legal sign-off on the addendum. Customer can provide redacted transcripts and a small PHI-containing set behind their firewall for on-prem testing.
onboard-bot: Intake created — CS-8271 — AstraNova: "legal-summarizer" — status: pending-safety-review — intake owner: Anya M.
Rahul P. (Safety): For timeline planning: we need 2 weeks for initial safety eval once we have the dataset + prompts. Please attach these to CS-8271 and include expected acceptance criteria.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Copy. Drafting acceptance criteria now. Example eval metrics to include: ROUGE/ROUGE-L, factuality checks (% hallucinations), PHI leakage scan (regex + PII model), and latency P95.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Adding sample config to ticket for clarity:
```
model_request:
  model_family: custom-13b-legal-summarizer
  languages: [en, es, fr]
  data_classification: PHI, PCI
  deployment: private (VPC)
  kms: customer-hsm (HSM-backed keywrap)
  latency_slo: p95 < 400ms (512 tokens)
  eval_set_size: 500 (redacted ok)
```
Sam C. (CSM): Thanks — I'll ask AstraNova for the synthetic/redacted eval set and a short runbook of their failure definitions. I'll also confirm whether they require on-prem package vs. VPC-only.
Liang W. (Runtime Eng): One more note — if they want aggressive 4-bit quantization + HSM disk encryption we might need an engineering spike to validate kernel compatibility. Tagging this as possible engineering work.
Rahul P. (Safety): Also request a list of high-risk prompts they worry about (e.g., contract extraction that might reveal PHI). We'll include targeted red-team tests.
Sam C. (CSM): Will do. I'll update CS-8271 with the initial artifacts by EOD tomorrow. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Great — I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with AstraNova next week after intake docs are attached.
Sam C. (CSM): Closing loop — customer ok with sharing redacted examples now. I'll push them into the ticket.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Perfect. Leaving this thread open for any blockers.
